## Summary

Problem, owning module, observable result, and linked issue.

## Evidence

List exact commands/results. Label focused, repository, package/offline-simulated, or live. Explain omitted relevant checks.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] Inputs are bounded and schema-validated at their seam.
- [ ] No secret, private repository content, customer data, or unredacted provider payload was added.
- [ ] Commands remain argv arrays with `shell: false`.
- [ ] Test-only, causal, environment, cleanup, digest, and draft-only invariants remain fail-closed.
- [ ] Contract/receipt compatibility was assessed; generated schemas were not hand-edited.
- [ ] Dependency/licensing and documentation/error behavior were handled when applicable.

## Contract/generated-file impact

State `none`, or list versions, producers/consumers, migration, generated files, and tests.

## Live validation

State `not run` unless explicitly authorized. If run, record sanitized scope and cleanup confirmation. Fixtures/offline demo are not live checks.

## Review notes

Dangerous negative paths, assumptions, limits, and follow-up. No private evidence.
